intro: The subjunctive for whatever, wherever and however, and three more ways of saying that an obstacle does not matter.
p.donde quieras.consejo: An undecided place takes the subjunctive: «siéntate donde quieras». With a chosen place: «donde quise».
p.como quieras.consejo: With the subjunctive: «hazlo como quieras». With the indicative it would be something known: «como dice el manual».
p.cuando quieras.consejo: It takes the subjunctive because the moment is not decided: «ven cuando quieras».
p.quien quiera.consejo: With no noun before it, «quien» is «the person who»: «quien quiera venir, que venga».
p.sea como sea.glosa: be that as it may; one way or another
p.sea como sea.consejo: It repeats «sea» in the subjunctive: «sea como sea, hay que terminarlo hoy».
p.cueste lo que cueste.consejo: It repeats «costar» in the subjunctive. It shows a firm decision.
p.vayas donde vayas.consejo: It repeats «ir» in the subjunctive: «vayas donde vayas, te acompañaré».
p.tanto si.consejo: It goes with «como si» and the indicative: «tanto si llueve como si hace sol».
p.incluso si.consejo: It uses the same tenses as «si»: «incluso si llueve, iré»; «incluso si lloviera, iría».
p.aun así.consejo: No accent on «aun»: it means «even». With an accent, «aún» is «still».
p.de todas maneras.consejo: You also say «de todos modos». It goes at the start of the sentence, with a comma.
p.le guste o no.glosa: whether he likes it or not
p.le guste o no.consejo: Subjunctive with «o no»: «le guste o no». For «tú»: «quieras o no».
b1.texto:
You know that a relative clause about something unknown takes the subjunctive: busco un piso que **tenga** luz. The same logic gives Spanish its way of saying -ever.

- Siéntate **donde quieras**. (wherever)
- Hazlo **como quieras**. (however)
- Ven **cuando puedas**. (whenever)
- Come **lo que quieras**. (whatever)
- **Quien quiera** venir, que venga. (whoever)
- **El que llegue** primero, que avise.

With the indicative, the same sentences talk about something known: me senté **donde quise**. Hazlo **como dice** el manual.

**The doubled formula.** Verb in the subjunctive + relative + the same verb:

- **Pase lo que pase**, te llamaré.
- **Digan lo que digan**, no pienso cambiar.
- **Vayas donde vayas**, encontrarás a un español.
- **Sea como sea**, hay que terminarlo hoy.
- **Cueste lo que cueste.**
- **Hagas lo que hagas**, no abras esa puerta.

**Tanto si… como si…** takes the indicative: **tanto si llueve como si** hace sol, iremos.

**Incluso si** takes the same tenses as «si»: **incluso si llueve**, iré; **incluso si lloviera**, iría. **Aun** + gerund means the same: **aun sabiendo** la verdad, calló.

**Aun** and **aún.** Without an accent, «even»: **aun así**. With an accent, «still»: **aún** no ha llegado.
b2.f0.texto: Grandpa, you can live wherever you like.
b2.f1.texto: I am staying in my house, whatever happens.
b2.f2.texto: Whenever you like, I'll take you.
b2.f3.texto: Whoever wants to visit me, let him come whenever he likes.
b2.f4.texto: Whether you like it or not, I will phone you every night.
b2.f5.texto: Even if I fall, I prefer that to living shut in.
b2.f6.texto: Even so, we worry about you.
b2.f7.texto: Anyway, I love you very much.
b2.f8.texto: Wherever you go, you will have a family waiting for you.
b2.f9.texto: Then, as you like, we eat together on Sunday.
b4.texto:
- **-quiera with the subjunctive** (something undecided): donde quieras, como quieras, cuando quieras, lo que quieras, quien quiera.
- **With the indicative** (something known): me senté donde quise.
- **The doubled formula**: pase lo que pase, digan lo que digan, vayas donde vayas, sea como sea, cueste lo que cueste.
- **Tanto si… como si…** + indicative.
- **Incluso si**: like «si»: incluso si llueve / incluso si lloviera.
- **Aun así**, **de todas maneras**: even so, anyway.
b4.e0.texto: Whether he likes it or not, he will have to accept it.
b4.e1.texto: Wherever you go, you will always find someone.
b4.e2.texto: Whether it rains or the sun shines, we will go.
b5.f0.texto: Grandfather's house stands alone at the end of a gravel path.
b5.f1.texto: Whatever it costs, he mends the gate every morning with an old hammer.
b5.f2.texto: He grows what he wants in the vegetable patch and eats when he is hungry.
b5.f3.texto: A cloud of smoke rises slowly from the chimney and fades into the cold air.
b5.f4.texto: Whatever happens, nobody moves him from his corner by the window.
b5.f5.texto: On Sundays, whoever wants to visit him finds the door open.
b5.f6.texto: There is a cup ready on the table for anyone who arrives.
b5.f7.texto: Even so, he always looks toward the path, as if waiting for a familiar voice.
b5.f8.texto: The afternoon light comes in unhurriedly, whether there are clouds or not.
b5.f9.texto: Anyway, the house keeps its warmth, whether it is winter or summer.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the same verb twice, both in the subjunctive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative. The formula repeats the subjunctive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It is future. Both halves take the subjunctive.
b6.pregunta: The doubled formula repeats the subjunctive.
b7.o0.refuerzo: It is an order, but the subjunctive comes from the undecided place.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Well done: what is unknown or not chosen takes the subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Irregularity does not explain the mood.
b7.pregunta: In «siéntate donde quieras», why the subjunctive?
b8.frase: Vayas donde vayas siempre encontrarás a alguien
b8.traduccion: Wherever you go, you will always find someone
b9.frase: Tanto si ____ como si hace sol, iremos.
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: after «si» comes the indicative, not the present subjunctive.
b9.o1.refuerzo: After «si» the present subjunctive never goes.
b9.o2.refuerzo: After «si» the future does not go; the present is used.
b9.pregunta: With «tanto si… como si…» the indicative goes.
b11.pregunta: In «aun así, lo hizo», what is «aun»?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: an undecided place takes the subjunctive.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative, for a place already known or chosen.
b12.o2.refuerzo: It is future, and «donde» does not take it here.
b12.pregunta: The place is not chosen: complete.
p.visitarme.consejo: «Me» at the end means «me». The v sounds like b. Stress on TAR.
p.llamaré.consejo: Future of «llamar». The ll sounds like y. Stress on RE.
p.encerrado.consejo: Participle of «encerrar», to shut in. The c before e is th and the rr is strong.
p.preocupamos.consejo: From «preocuparse», to worry. Stress on PA.
p.tendrás.consejo: Future of «tener», to have. Stress on DRAS.
p.aceptarlo.consejo: «Lo» at the end means «it». The c before e is th. Stress on TAR.
p.encontrarás.consejo: Future of «encontrar», to find. Stress on RAS.
p.iremos.consejo: Future of «ir», to go. Stress on RE: i-RE-mos.
p.grava.consejo: Feminine, «la grava». The v sounds like b. Stress on GRA.
p.arregla.consejo: From «arreglar», to fix. The rr at the start of the stressed syllable is strong.
p.martillo.consejo: Masculine, «el martillo». The ll sounds like y. Stress on TI.
p.cultiva.consejo: From «cultivar», to grow crops. The v sounds like b.
p.visitarlo.consejo: «Lo» at the end means «him» here. The v sounds like b.
p.esperara.consejo: Imperfect subjunctive of «esperar», to wait. Stress on RA.
p.decidido.consejo: Participle of «decidir», to decide. The c before i is th. Stress on DI.
p.quieras.consejo: Subjunctive of «querer», to want. The ie is a diphthong: KIE-ras.
